from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u051/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-2ff7395c.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(cell == value for row in grid for cell in row))
    objects = []
    for row in grid:
        previous = background
        for value in row:
            if value != background and value != previous:
                objects.append(value)
            previous = value
    cells = sorted(objects, reverse=True)[:6]
    cells += [0] * (6 - len(cells))
    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]
'''
path.write_text(source)
